root.command: SELECT CustomerID, NextCoffeeBy, LastCupCount, DailyConsumption, DateDiff("d", NextCoffeeBy, Now()) AS DaysOverdue FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", -90, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy < Now() ORDER BY NextCoffeeBy
SELECT COUNT(*) AS RecordsToUpdate FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", -90, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy < Now()
UPDATE ClientUsageTbl SET NextCoffeeBy = DateAdd("d", 7, Now()) WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", -90, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy < Now()

SELECT CustomerID, NextCoffeeBy, LastCupCount, DailyConsumption, DateDiff("d", Now(), NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilCheckup FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 8, Now()) ORDER BY CustomerID

SELECT 'Total Records' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM ClientUsageTbl UNION ALL SELECT 'Overdue (0-90 days)' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", -90, Now()) AND NextCoffeeBy < Now() UNION ALL SELECT 'Very Old (90+ days overdue)' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy < DateAdd("d", -90, Now()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Future Dates' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM ClientUsageTbl WHERE NextCoffeeBy >= Now()
